title: Srikanth Stuns Lai, Satwik-Chirag Advance in China Masters
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers Kidambi Srikanth and the men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty secured important victories in the China Masters.
summary: Kidambi Srikanth upset Lai with a 21-18, 21-19 win, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also won their matches at the China Masters, though Tanvi lost her match.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course will enhance the coaching standards for badminton in India, impacting future player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing an Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's young talent is being prepared at the National Center of Excellence for upcoming major Asian junior championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will affect how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This notification directly impacts the selection process for India's representation at the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification regarding a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been issued by BAI.
